title: Pure iron pillar of Delhi
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Pure iron pillar of Delhi, about Antiquity at Delhi, India, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and they still stand. Or take the pillar in the center of Delhi in India.

plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens, points to an iron pillar standing in the center of Delhi, India. He describes it as pure iron that still stands after a very long time, offering it as an example of ancient work that is hard to explain.
